film.title: Signal Fire
film.promptPreamble: Photoreal coastal night cinema, anamorphic 2.39:1 framing cropped to 16:9, hard sodium practicals against deep blue ambient, fine 35mm grain, salt haze, real spray. Consistent character: THE WATCHER is a woman in her forties, cropped grey-streaked hair, black oilskin over a cable-knit sweater. Realtime speed, brisk natural motion. Native audio: wind, surf, and a low sustained score. No dialogue, no on-screen lettering.

shots.prompt: 0-4s: locked wide on a basalt headland, a single storm lantern burning at frame right, surf detonating below. 4-7s: THE WATCHER enters from frame left and crouches to the lantern, shielding it with her body. 7-10s: she lifts her head to look out to sea, and holds. Camera stays locked throughout.

0-5s: slow push in on THE WATCHER's face lit only by the lantern, sodium orange on one side, blue night on the other. 5-9s: her eyes track something moving right to left offscreen. 9-12s: she stands and the frame follows her up, the horizon dropping into the lower third. Handheld with restrained micro-shake.
